findings.title: TODO left unresolved: manuscript text is hardcoded empty
findings.description: /reader/analyze has TODO for manuscript text fetch; currently returns empty report.
findings.impact: Real analysis path unreachable until manuscript storage is wired.
findings.suggestion: Implement manuscript retrieval in future phase; current behavior matches task scope.

findings.title: Duplicate pattern entries in AI_TEMPLATE_PATTERNS
findings.description: Several Chinese template patterns are duplicated, inflating match counts.
findings.impact: Template score may be artificially high for duplicated patterns.
findings.suggestion: Deduplicate AI_TEMPLATE_PATTERNS.

findings.title: Potential division by zero in ConsensusEngine.calculateDimensionSummaries
findings.description: scores.length could be 0 if reactions lack a dimension key.
findings.suggestion: Guard against empty scores array and filter undefined values.

findings.title: Feedback aggregate 'modify' action never triggers weight adjustment
findings.description: 'ignore' increments the 'modify' counter but the weight adjustment logic only compares accept vs reject.
findings.impact: Ignore action contributes to threshold but is discarded in adjustment.
findings.suggestion: Incorporate modify count into weight logic or rename action.

findings.title: DetailPanel consensus matching by description is fragile
findings.description: Matches OverlayMarker to ConsensusItem by exact description string.
findings.impact: Matches may fail if descriptions are truncated or merged.
findings.suggestion: Use stable identifier for matching.

findings.title: RevisionService weak points based on original text only
findings.description: Weak points are derived from baseline analysis, not current draft.
findings.suggestion: Re-analyze current draft each iteration.

findings.title: No input length limits on text fields
findings.description: Endpoints accept arbitrary-length text without size validation.
findings.suggestion: Add max text length check (e.g. 50000 chars).

findings.title: Persona file path from environment variable without sanitization
findings.description: NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE is trimmed but not validated.
findings.impact: Path traversal possible if env var is untrusted.
findings.suggestion: Resolve and validate workspace root is within allowed base.

findings.title: LLM API key sent without HTTPS/timeout validation
findings.description: No HTTPS protocol check or request timeout on LLM fetch.
findings.impact: API key could leak to attacker-controlled endpoint; hangs possible.
findings.suggestion: Enforce HTTPS, add timeout, allowlist safe domains.

findings.title: No validation of persona parameter numeric ranges
findings.description: Weight fields accept NaN, Infinity, and out-of-range values.
findings.suggestion: Validate finite numbers in [0,1] range.

findings.title: Frontend imports backend types directly
findings.description: ReportGenerator imports types from ../../../../src-ts/reader/ConsensusEngine.
findings.suggestion: Extract shared types or duplicate minimal types.

findings.title: Manual singleton pattern instead of DI
findings.description: Multiple lazy singletons with module-level mutable state.
findings.suggestion: Use DI container or injectable service instances.

findings.title: RevisionService dynamic import with .js extension
findings.description: Dynamic import of '../mcp/services/critic.js' bypasses type checking.
findings.impact: Runtime failure risk if build output differs.
findings.suggestion: Use static import or stable interface.

findings.title: DIMENSION_TO_PARAM mapping has redundant entries
findings.description: Map contains 12 entries for 4 dimensions with 3 naming conventions.
findings.suggestion: Normalize dimension names to single canonical form.

findings.title: AI template patterns duplicated between detector and revision-service
findings.description: Pattern lists defined in both files and already diverged.
findings.suggestion: Extract shared ai-templates module.

findings.title: Severity color logic duplicated across components
findings.description: SEVERITY_COLORS/DIMENSION_LABELS duplicated.
findings.suggestion: Extract shared constants.

findings.title: ConsensusBar duplicated in DetailPanel and ReportGenerator
findings.description: Nearly identical bar components in two files.
findings.suggestion: Extract shared ConsensusBar component.

findings.title: ReportGenerator dimensionSummaries fallback overwrites avgScore
findings.description: Fallback overwrites avgScore with last persona's score instead of averaging.
findings.impact: Incorrect scores shown in fallback path.
findings.suggestion: Compute actual average or remove fallback.

findings.title: require used inside function instead of static import
findings.description: getPersonasFilePath uses require('node:path').
findings.suggestion: Use static import.

findings.title: Inline SVG instead of lucide-react icons
findings.description: Thumbs up/down icons are inline SVG.
findings.suggestion: Use lucide-react ThumbsUp/ThumbsDown.

findings.title: Unused React import in DetailPanel
findings.description: Imports React but only uses useState.
findings.suggestion: Use named import.
